A '''strap-chair''' was a chair designed to restrain its occupant. During his time as an interrogator for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Akanseh]] interrogated a [[Unidentified resistance fighter (Kal'Shebbol)|resistance fighter]] who was restrained in a strap-chair.
